services.name: Deluxe Plus Cabin
services.desc: This cabin is 12′ X 20′ on shaded sites with electricity inside, water outside, two queen beds, bunk beds, a folding table, porch, fire ring, and picnic table. It also features a microwave, small fridge, coffee maker, TV/DVD with Cable TV, electric fireplace, A/C, and an outside propane BBQ with a side burner. This cabin can sleep up to six people. These Cabins do not include cooking utensils, bedding, linens, or towels. Minimum 2 Night stay. Nightly rates range from $135 to $205 depending on time of season.
